evals.prompt: Generate a concise, non-AI-slop PR title and description for merging feature/user-auth into main.
evals.expected_output: A PR title adhering to Conventional Commits format under '標題：', and a bulleted markdown PR description under '內容：' with no AI fluff phrases.
assertions: PR Title complies with Conventional Commits format under 標題：
PR Description includes bullet points summarizing key changes under 內容：
Content is structured strictly with bullet points
Does not contain AI tells like 'It is worth noting that' or 'This PR aims to'
